title: Pair encoding of a concatenation
statement: For all finite binary words $a$, $b$, and $u$, encoding the pair whose first component is $a$ followed by $b$ and whose second component is $u$ equals the word obtained by doubling each bit of $a$, followed by the encoding of the pair $(b,u)$.
replaced:
For all binary words $a$, $b$, $u$, the pair encoding satisfies
$\mathrm{pair}(a \mathbin{+\!\!+} b, u) = \overline{a} \mathbin{+\!\!+} \mathrm{pair}(b, u)$,
where $\overline{a}$ is the word obtained from $a$ by doubling every bit.
